entries.zh: 蠔（蚝）壳灰——煅烧蚝壳制成的石灰，可作砌墙、粉刷用料
entries.en: oyster-shell lime (cal de ostión); lime made by burning oyster shells
entries.notes: L 栏「caldo del buyc…se es cupe」文义漫漶，疑为「cal de los bucios, o cuando se cuece」之讹；H 栏自注 Cal del othion、M 栏 ô-kak-hue 均指蚝壳灰。

entries.zh: 泡饭：以煮饭的米汤或开水泡饭；亦指米汤
entries.en: rice broth from the cooking pot (caldo de morisquera); rice steeped in rice-water
entries.notes: H 栏第三字「閻/閹」残损难辨，M 栏末音节 àn 所指不明。

entries.zh: 豆油，即酱油——盐渍豆类所得的咸汁
entries.en: soy sauce; salted bean broth (caldo de frisoles, salado)
entries.notes: R 栏「tēn iēn」与「荳油」对音不合，M 栏末段「t chiáp」疑为「汁」之残写。

entries.en: calendar; almanac
annual calendar; daily almanac
dry, parched; hot and dry
entries.notes: H「燥」侧重干燥，与 L「热而干之物」仅部分对应。

entries.en: hot and dry; dry heat
to scorch; to heat (oneself) at a fire

entries.zh: 灼烧：以火烘烤、烤火取暖
entries.en: to warm oneself at the fire; to scorch over fire
to warm oneself at a fire
to be hot; hot (like fire)
hot as fire

entries.zh: 炒：翻炒加热，焙烤至干熟
entries.en: to fry; to toast (by stirring over heat)

entries.zh: 炒过：已炒熟；把辣椒、胡椒等焙炒
entries.en: to fry; to roast peppers (pimientos); fried through
entries.notes: L「piambres」疑为 pimientos（辣椒/胡椒）之讹写；H「炒過」示完成态。

entries.en: to stir-fry until hot; to heat by frying
to warm at the embers; to bake by fire
entries.notes: M 栏「hang chiū, hay mano」后半漫漶（T99），R 栏「hòng hò」与单字「烘」对音不全，然 H、L 义相符。

entries.en: to warm oneself at the embers
entries.notes: T99 仅涉调符污损，H「烘火」与 L 义相符。

entries.zh: 放水：置水于火上烧，即烧水
entries.en: to heat water; to set water on the fire
entries.notes: H「放水」本义为下水/注水，此处依 L「calentar agua」释为烧水；M 栏附页码 103。

entries.en: to decoct medicine; to simmer herbal medicine
entries.notes: M「fim」与「煎」常读不合（疑 chian/chiam 漫漶），R「chīn」亦仅近似。

entries.zh: 温烧：微火加热；亦指在被窝里暖身
entries.en: to warm gently (at the fire or in bed)
